description: This is a Java source file implementing enforcement logic for 'ThingCommand' operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages authorization, access control, caching, and interactions with shard regions for Things and Policies, including creation, modification, retrieval, and permission checks.

classes.name: CreateThingWithEnforcer
classes.description: A data class holding a CreateThing command and its associated Enforcer for policy or ACL enforcement.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: A static inner class providing enforcement provider implementation for ThingCommand, managing dependencies and instantiation.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Main method to trigger enforcement logic for a ThingCommand, returning a completion stage with enforced headers.

methods.name: doEnforce
methods.description: Performs enforcement based on whether an enforcer exists or needs creation, dispatching to specific enforcement routines.

methods.name: enforceThingCommandByNonexistentEnforcer
methods.description: Handles enforcement when the target thing or its policy does not have an existing enforcer, possibly triggering creation.

methods.name: enforceThingCommandByAclEnforcer
methods.description: Authorizes a command via ACL enforcer, with special handling for retrieving and migrating ACLs.

methods.name: enforceThingCommandByPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Authorizes a command via policy enforcer with support for query commands and response handling.

methods.name: retrieveThingAndPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves a thing and its associated policy, building a combined view if authorized.

methods.name: retrieveThingBeforePolicy
methods.description: Queries for a thing before policy enforcement, handling timeout and error cases.

methods.name: reportThingUnavailable
methods.description: Generates a timeout exception indicating the thing is unavailable.

methods.name: retrieveInlinedPolicyForThing
methods.description: Fetches the inlined or default policy associated with a thing, handling retrieval responses.

methods.name: getCorrelationIdOrNull
methods.description: Extracts correlation ID from headers or response for logging.

methods.name: buildJsonViewForThingQueryCommandResponse
methods.description: Restricts the JSON entity of a response based on enforcement policies.

methods.name: errorForExistingThingWithDeletedPolicy
methods.description: Creates an exception for trying to access a thing with a missing or deleted policy.

methods.name: errorForThingCommand
methods.description: Maps a command to its corresponding exception.

methods.name: enforceCreateThingBySelf
methods.description: Enforces creation of a thing based on its own authorization context.
